programmes.d: Yuko's worried about Momo and dives into her dreams again to get the magical girl to open up. However, is that a good idea? Who knows what could happen this time.
Musashino Animation's next project is announced and Aoi is assigned to the production desk.
Momo needs to process the shocking revelations that rocked her to the core! Perhaps Yuko can solve the dilemma by offering Momo a deal with a demon girl.
While auditioning for a part, Shizuka is asked to read for another character; Seiichi attends the casting meeting.
Hiraku won't waste his second chance at life; he will focus on what truly matters. And so, he builds a new home with his own two hands.
After welcoming the new employees, Musashino Animation dives into production for Third Aerial Girls Squad; Aoi's hard work may come to a screeching halt.
As the weeks turn into months, Hiraku's loneliness grows. He thought he desired a life of solitude, but his wish for companionship grows stronger by the day.
Yumi revises the character designs based on the author's feedback; however, his disapproval continues.
Hiraku and Lu begin their new life together, unaware of the visitors who will soon arrive at their household.
The announcement of the anime adaptation for "The Third Girls Aerial Squad" is met with skepticism and the studio is forced into quickly completing a promotional video.
Now that they've secured a reliable water source, they can start a rice paddy and build a bathhouse.
Ookura agrees to work on a scene with Aoi but forgets the next day; Musashino receives the layouts for the fifth episode.
With their homestead completed, they turn their focus to food preparation and just in time; Winter is coming.
Aoi cracks under the pressure of Erika's return and asks her to take over; Erika visits the Taitanic office to sort things out.
A surprise attack would have shattered their peaceful lives were it not for the almighty farming tool. As word spreads, their home blooms into a village.
Hiraoka implies that Midori is getting writing projects because she's a girl and argues with the director.
Hiraku realizes the importance of diplomacy when the demon lord and the dragons establish contact with the Great Tree Village.
Aoi receives complaints from Segawa, who wants Hiraoka taken off the episodes she is working on.
They say civilization started because of alcohol. In the Great Tree Village's case, it instigates a misunderstanding between dragons.
Yumi nominates Ema to join Rinko as an assistant general animation supervisor.
Hiraku's offhand remark leads to a series of events that conclude with a merchant, establishing trade relationships with The Great Tree Village.
Seiichi reaches out to Nogame to try to settle the anime's ending; Chazawa's lack of action comes to light.
Spurred by her followers, the demon lord's daughter attempts to invade the Great Tree Village. “Attempts” being the keyword.
All that is left to do is deliver the final tapes to the TV stations, but Aoi's delivery may not make it in time.
News of the impending birth thrills the villagers, but they aren't the only ones interested in the good news.
A loner is tricked into joining the "Services Club" and must help students with their problems.
Hiraku's second chance was just the beginning. As he reflects on the changes that occurred since his arrival, one thing is certain: The Great Tree Village is lively as always.
Yui tries to either fit in or break away from her social group; the club receives a request from an old friend of Hachiman's.
When Isuzu Sento asks him out, Seiya Kanie assumes it is a date. The reality is quite beyond his imagination.
Another student comes to Hachiman with a request for the club.
Sento's rather fantastical story regarding the park and its inhabitants isn't the only surprise in store: Kanie's about to meet those attempting to shut the place down.
Hachiman has a crisis concerning little sisters and receives a mysterious text.
Usui meets Misaki's mom and helps her, and she invites him home for tea. Misaki drags him from her home. When her friends see them leave together, what else would they think?
Hachiman's sister has been acting strange and the Service Club wants to find out why.
It's the Sports Festival, and the boys have decided that the Grand Prize is a kiss from a horrified Sakura. Misaki competes to save her, despite all efforts to disqualify her.
Hachiman and Yui go on a recruitment drive to find more members.
Aratake, the strongest delinquent in school, can't believe Naoya, a former gang leader, has gone soft; the gang abducts Yukimura, whom they mistake for Naoya's girlfriend.
Shizuka repeatedly calls and texts Hachiman as he tries to relax during summer vacation.
The Student Council plans an open house at Seika High to boost female enrollment. However, a girl-hating freshman, Soutarou, goes to extreme measures to derail their efforts.
Shizuka prepares a bonfire and a test of courage; Yui recognizes the limo that hit Hachiman.
Soutarou is shocked to find that Misaki was able to outlast his little game. Misaki has a special punishment in mind for the freshman at the upcoming Open House.
Hachiman becomes restless as summer comes to an end; a firework festival opens the door for more teasing.
It's the summer vacation, and the Maid Latte crew has been invited to Satsuki's sister's beach resort. Aoi tags along, too, but why did Satsuki bring Usui?
Yui sees the rift forming between Hachiman and Yukino; Hachiman is asked to serve on the committee for the school's cultural festival.
It's the second day of vacation, and Aoi needs Misa's help to win the beach volleyball tournament! The winners are crowned Beach Prince and Princess, so why is Usui competing?
Hachiman and Yui check on Yukino; Hachiman shakes things up with the committee.
The Miyabigaoka Student Council aims to buy out Maid Latte and replace it with a butler cafe. The only way for Misa to stop this is to enter the footman auditions in disguise.
The cultural festival continues and Hachiman documents the day's events on film.
Usui and Misaki must cooperate to succeed in the second round of the footman auditions, but before the third round begins, disaster strikes.
A request to helm the upcoming sports festival arrives, and the group must band together to pull it off.
Yukimura's sister loves playing princess but her brother's not princely enough. She's smitten by Prince Usui, so Yukimura arranges a date for them to regain her favor.
At first glance, he's just the disturbed boy, and she's just the popular girl; people are more than the sum of their parts, as both Kyotaro and Anna come to discover.
Sakura wants to confess her feelings to her crush, Nozaki. Unfortunately, when she does, he thinks she is just a fan of his shojo manga.
Ichikawa starts to tolerate Yamada's presence as they find themselves alone once again in his favorite retreat, the library.
Nozaki's friend and fellow manga artist Mikoshiba pays a visit. Considering Mikoshiba is pretty much Nozaki's foil, Sakura can't figure out how or why the two are friends.
Anna and her friends keep their guard up around the boys; it's obvious what they want, but Kyotaros is different; each brief interaction brings him and Anna closer together.
Sakura learns that she and Mikoshiba aren't the only ones helping Nozaki with his mangas. Concerned with who may be cozying up to Nozaki, Sakura is on a new mission.
Like many people his own age, Kyotaro has a tendency to overthink everything; Anna, however, has her own way of approaching life.
Mikoshiba is invited to a mixer, but isn't sure about his social skills. Fortunately, with a little help from Nozaki and Sakura, he might be able to figure it out just enough.
The class splits into groups for a trip, and Ichikawa gets into the group with Yamada and the other girls. He begins to suffer under the guidance of Yamada's friend Sekine.
When Sakura notices that Nozaki's apartment is pristine, she panics, worried that he's trying to impress another girl. What she discovers is even more irritating.
Kyotaro wrestles with his feelings as he notices Anna's strange behavior. The library enforces a no-eating rule, and Kyotaro worries Anna won't visit anymore.
Nozaki gives Wakamatsu a gift to help him fight his insomnia, but what he doesn't tell him is that this gift may also be his worst nightmare.
Kyotaro finally admits to himself that he likes Anna, but wonders about her feelings for him. Kyotaro learns that Anna will be on a weekly TV program.
Nozaki needs inspiration for his artwork so Sakura decides to take him on what she believes is a date, but a few awkward encounters make her reconsider.
Kyotaro gets anxious during the Parent Teacher Conference because his mother is at school, and she is talking to Anna. Later, Kyotaro gets sick and Anna visits him.
Posing manga characters is a never-ending challenge for Nozaki, but two of his models may become a real life couple!
Kyotaro refuses to believe that Anna could actually like him despite all the hints she has been throwing his way and the perception of those around them.
Kyotaro and Anna hang out during Christmas and go pancake eating and shopping. Later, they encounter Kyotaro's sister.
Sakura and Nozaki find themselves living in a real-life manga, but while Sakura daydreams of romance it's no surprise to find that Nozaki is completely clueless.
Distance separates Kyotaro and Anna, but they are thinking of each other; their budding relationship faces a threat; Haruya still has his eyes set on Anna.
The group has various repeated, awkward attempts at love, and it appears some people are catching on to who they are in Nozaki's manga.
Kyotaro didn't think his cunning plan for New Year's all the way through; Anna showed up early and his sister is trying to be his wingwoman.
Nozaki is up to his usual social experiments, and this time Sakura isn't the only one being tricked and observed! This time the guys are the focus.
The Demon Lord is defeated by a human hero; to find his replacement, the demon kin hold a competition; Helck, a human and mortal enemy, is among the participants.
After numerous failed attempts at grabbing Nozaki's attention, it finally seems as though Sakura may have the perfect opportunity.
Helck continues to rack up victories as a fan favorite of the crowd; he proceeds on to the semifinals race.
When challenging an archnemesis to a duel, please make sure they do not mistake it as an invitation to hang out. It's awkward for everyone involved.
Helck displays a lot of strength and leaves Vermilio increasingly concerned about the threat he poses.
Mikan realizes something - she recognizes the box that seals Shamiko's dad. That means the factory ruins on the outskirts of town hold clues about Momo's sister! Maybe.
After Helck blocks an attack meant for Edil, Vermilio becomes convinced that he is an enemy; the floor gives way and everyone falls into a dark underground room.
After hearing that Lilith has been sealed for over 2000 years, Shamiko and Momo come up with a plan to let her borrow Shamiko's body and enjoy a day of freedom.
The power of the gate sends Vermilio and Helck to a remote island; Vermilio travels deeper into the island and comes across a fluffy creature.
Shamiko visits a cafe rumored to be frequented by demons in search of clues about Sakura, but somehow ends up getting a part-time job instead!
Vermilio poses a question to Helck about fighting against old friends; the others at Castle Urum are fighting winged knights.
Shamiko learns that Lico and Shirosawa have a connection to Sakura and decides to continue working part-time at the cafe. However, Momo is vehemently opposed to it!
Hyura and the others escape Castle Urum, but soon find themselves surrounded again; Azudra arrives to subdue the winged knights; Azudra begins plotting.
When Shamiko finds herself in trouble, the one who saves her is none other than Sakura Chiyoda! Meanwhile, Momo takes a certain action to save Shamiko from her nightmare.
Azudra determines the winged knights are a major threat; Helck and Vermilio take it easy.
Shamiko's summer vacation has turned out far more hectic than intended. She tries to reclaim some peace in her life, but the looming stack of homework casts a dark shadow...
Helck and Vermilio bid farewell to the mysterious island and its residents as they sail away with a stowaway Piwi aboard; they run into a massive whirlpool.
Helck and company end up in the Erille Kingdom where they must fight the barbarians of the Tothman Tribe; the Tothman King goes berserk after tapping into a mysterious power.
Shamiko promises to visit the zoo with Momo and Mikan and tries making boxed lunches for them. She'll need help to make something tasty, so Shamiko visits a certain address.
Helck and company use their winnings from the cooking competition to buy a map leading to the Empire; they make plans to go northwest into the ruins of two destroyed kingdoms.
Momo is stuck in her darkness form! Without the ability to control her strength, Momo unintentionally destroys whatever she touches.
Vermilio is frightened by Helck's power as he goes berserk during his battle with Augis; it makes her recall the words of the Great Witch who warned her about Helck.
Shamiko can't use her magic rod right because of a lack of imagination. Special training in Lilith's sealed space will help her. Maybe.
When they were little, Helck and his younger brother Cless lost both of their parents; one day, Cless gets very sick and Helck begs for someone to save him.
